verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an agent identity and payments platform, so pushed order or transaction lifecycle events (webhooks or an event subscription API) are a fair capability to ask about. The evidence pack shows no such mechanism: it documents only synchronous calls (charge token, introspect token, wallet balance) and MCP tools for token creation and seller discovery. No webhook, event-subscription, or created/updated/fulfilled/canceled order notifications appear anywhere in the pack.
